newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market quiet, no fresh orders.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market quiet, no fresh orders.

text.p: Shipbrokers reported no fresh business on the London sugar freight market on Tuesday as the new orders cited at the start the week remained uncovered.
"I think the market is pretty quiet," said one, adding that it was surprising that south Brazil was not accounting for more business due to its seasonal busy shipping period.
Brazilian portworkers have all but called off a national strike on Aug 11 after colleagues at three ports received collective wage offers.
The ports of Vitoria, Rio de Janeiro, Aratu and Salvador have received offers for a three percent salary raise. All except Vitoria have already signed new collective wage agreements.
